routines.title: Daily Blog Publishing
runbook: Choose and record one inclusive random quantity from 20 through 25.
Select commercially relevant outsourcing topics, reject duplicates and cannibalization, and create an internal brief for every article.
Research current facts and one authoritative external article per standard blog, then draft the complete site article structure.

Validate headings, intent, metadata, canonical URL, schema, CTAs, exactly two distinct contextual internal article-body links, exactly one authoritative external article-body link, three related article cards, and no placeholders, em dashes, or double hyphens.
Run the official blader/humanizer process from https://github.com/blader/humanizer, version 2.9.1 or later, then run factual, structural, link, schema, and protected-element validation again.
Assign and render the approved deterministic thumbnail, validate its source path and output, and update required indexes and sitemap inputs.

Run the repository build, fetch and rebase main, stage only intended batch files, commit, push to main, confirm the pushed commit SHA, and record repository, branch, SHA, files, UTC push time, and validation outcomes.
Stop after the verified GitHub push.

routines.title: Daily Research Publishing
runbook: Choose and record one inclusive random quantity from 10 through 15.

Select a niche-specific statistics, cost, salary, benchmark, ROI, adoption, trend, percentage, or comparison topic in a planned cluster; reject duplicates and cannibalization and create an internal brief.
Identify a liftable headline statistic, gather at least 10 real sources, explain methodology, and draft the complete research structure.

Validate headings, verified date, reading time, source count and visible source list, Key Stats, Key Takeaways, traceable numbers, tables, source notes, internal links, FAQs, related research cards, metadata, canonical URL, sitemap input, and schema.

Run the official blader/humanizer process from https://github.com/blader/humanizer, version 2.9.1 or later, with restrained evidence-first behavior, then run factual, structural, source, link, schema, and protected-element validation again.
Assign and render the approved deterministic thumbnail, validate its source path and output, and update required indexes, cluster data, related mappings, and sitemap inputs.

Run the repository build and structured-data validation, fetch and rebase main, stage only intended batch files, commit, push to main, confirm the pushed commit SHA, and record repository, branch, SHA, files, UTC push time, and validation outcomes.
Stop after the verified GitHub push.

routines.title: Batched Coolify Deployment
runbook: Check the current production cycle's daily Blog completion manifest; require every item and all validation evidence, including images, metadata, links, CTAs, schema, related content, and a successful build. On any missing or non-complete item, emit exactly SKIPPED_INCOMPLETE and stop until the next scheduled run.

Resolve and verify the exact domain-to-repository-to-production-branch-to-Coolify-application mapping for OutsourcingSmallBusinesses.com and Onboarding before mutation; never select by partial name and never enable GitHub auto-deploy.

Reconcile persisted deployment state and the current Git SHA before mutation. If the batch is already live emit ALREADY_DEPLOYED; if unchanged emit NO_NEW_CHANGES; if the SHA has queued or active deployment emit DEPLOYMENT_ALREADY_PENDING or DEPLOYMENT_IN_PROGRESS; if a successful deployment exists, verify the live site and emit LIVE_VERIFIED only after exact-commit and new-blog-page verification.

Combine the completed Blog changes into one validated commit and one push to the verified production branch. Never push per article. Use only protected COOLIFY_API_URL, COOLIFY_API_TOKEN, and COOLIFY_APPLICATION_UUID; never expose or persist secret values.

Inspect the global Coolify deployment queue across the server once. If queued count is three or more, emit exactly SKIPPED_COOLIFY_QUEUE, submit nothing, do not poll, and retry only at the next scheduled run.

With fewer than three queued deployments, recheck the exact application and SHA duplicate guard, then trigger exactly one manual deployment. Persist only non-secret domain, Paperclip project, application UUID, Git SHA, deployment UUID, UTC trigger time, accepted status, and observed queued count; an accepted request is DEPLOYMENT_SUBMITTED, not success.

On later runs reconcile persisted deployment/SHA before any mutation. Never blindly retry an uncertain request. If active emit DEPLOYMENT_IN_PROGRESS; if failed emit DEPLOYMENT_FAILED without an automatic duplicate; after success verify the exact SHA and new Blog pages on the live domain and emit LIVE_VERIFIED.

Every execution must finish with exactly one allowed outcome: SKIPPED_INCOMPLETE, NO_NEW_CHANGES, ALREADY_DEPLOYED, DEPLOYMENT_ALREADY_PENDING, SKIPPED_COOLIFY_QUEUE, DEPLOYMENT_SUBMITTED, DEPLOYMENT_IN_PROGRESS, DEPLOYMENT_FAILED, or LIVE_VERIFIED.
